checks.label: new reliability regressions and boundary replay

changes.finding: Active-job duplication swallowed a failed original autosave and could silently copy stale data; adding a copy could partially update only the original first.
changes.fix: Create fresh original/copy snapshots in memory and persist the complete named-job list with one setItem call. Preserve the sample-to-plant conversion guard.
changes.evidence: reliability-red.log: first three regressions failed; reliability-backtest.log: all pass

changes.finding: Repeated unchanged named-job render replaced list controls and lost keyboard focus.
changes.fix: Compare visible metadata/list state and keep unchanged controls intact. Status messages update directly.
changes.evidence: reliability-red.log: keyboard-focus regression failed; reliability-backtest.log: pass
